reviews.comment: Says attendance isn't mandatory and then threatens to invoke 7.5.1 lmao

Lecture videos are a little boring, but he's really caring and detailed through email or office hours. Quizzes and exams are taken directly from the videos. This class is the crux of technical interviews so it's worth going the extra mile.

This online asynchronous class was very organized and clear throughout. Also Professor Klappenecker is always willing to help and replied very quickly to any questions. The main problem was that the lectures and textbook notes were somewhat difficult to understand at first, but it wasn't too much of a problem if you're willing to put in extra time.

The lectures are useless and boring and don't help on homeworks. Quizzes are online/take home. TAs are usually quite lenient on homework grading as long as you try. HW is in Latex which is super annoying and a waste of time. First exam is very hard, you basically have to memorize everything from the slides. I'd try to take an easier prof.

Very passionate about the topics he teaches and has a sense of humor and cares about his students learning the material. Tests were tough, but they were fair and didn't throw any curveballs. I don't think I learned from his lectures very much and didn't fell like he was able to teach more complex topics very well. Hard class regardless of professor

Be prepared to spend hours a week teaching yourself insanely hard material that feels completely useless. Lectures where super boring and his way of explaining things left me feeling like a learned negatively if that makes sense. Take the other 411 professor if you have the choice. They have it 100x easier. Its like two completely different courses
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: CSCE 640 - Quantum algorithms can be difficult to learn, but the class was structured to allow for an easy entry into the material. The material was efficiently presented with a good mix of proofs and practical examples. Learning the material in the class was much easier than trying to learn it independently, which is how any prof should be rated.

math heavy class. online, no-proctor quizzes every other week weren't terrible if u are familiar w material & can control f. no coding except for occasional pseudocode on hw. weekly hw, typeset in latex, covers textbook problems & graders go easy. lectures pretty boring from slides. midterm & final guidelines were clear but covered SO MUCH content.

Absolutely horrible German professor whose teaching logic is confusing and broken. He puts tons of theoretically math proof and equations for an algorithm class. Nobody needs or cares to know those proof! Exam is difficult and homework using Latex takes a long time to complete. Wouldn't recommend anyone taking it.

No good. He teaches so much difficult, absolutely useless math proof stuffs for the algorithm course. Compared to other sections his class is so useless and hard. For the assignment he asks students to use Latex and you have to type in all those equations by hand. Ridiculous, avoid this prof at all cost

The actual material of the class is not too bad, but when learning it the first time it can be very difficult to understand. He teaches the concept in a beginner friendly way if you take the time to look up and understand some of the terms used otherwise things are a bit cryptic. The tests are very reasonable and dont really test critical thinking

His textbook and lectures were so useless. His notation stinks so bad you must have taken some 400 level math class to understand them even though the pre-requisite is calculus 1. He is super useless and just tells you to re-read the textbook and re-watch videos if you don't understand.

I believe that Dr. Klappenecker is given an unfair reputation by the ratings here. Yes, the lectures and book are difficult to understand initially, there is something to that. However, he is available for an incredible amount of time to actually help you understand specific concepts. Attend office hours and ask questions, and you will do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's not a horrible professor, but his lectures aren't particularly entertaining. Be prepared to read a lot if you want to get a good grade on the exams.

Lecture material is very confusing: it's mainly him just reading off a powerpoint with some explanation (confusing) on the subject. Weekly homework will take a good amount of hours each, and test/final are unbearably difficult. He makes an already-difficult class all the more difficult for no reason. If you can, definitely take another professor.
His lecture material was very confusing and hard to follow, and he was tough to understand at times. And the homework really sucks, be prepared to spend lots of time on it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He builds a good theoretical framework to understand the foundations of CS, and is pretty funny, too!

Does not explain things well. The textbook does not explain anything but rather asks you to explain the things you are trying to learn. Worst professor ever. Good luck getting a good grade in this class. RIP my GPA.
